component.name: WiFi Analyzer
component.summary: Inspect nearby Wi-Fi networks and channels

description.p: WiFi Analyzer shows nearby wireless networks, their signal strength, channel and security mode.
Add zoom and guidance to the interactive channel view.
Add interactive channel filtering and expanded connection diagnostics.
Add a profile-scoped local signal history graph for selected access points.
Show the measured active-link Wi-Fi generation in the network list.
Fix channel detection, safe scan handling, filtered exports, package support, a Swedish manual, and active-link Wi-Fi generation identification.
Add a new WiFi Analyzer logo and desktop application icon.
Add a 20-language gettext translation framework and compile translations in Flatpak builds.
Add actionable system notifications for Wi-Fi connection problems.
Add interference explanations, connection diagnostics, profile history, and monitoring notifications.
Add location profiles and optional background scan monitoring with change notifications.
Add active-connection details, scan comparison, measured channel width, anonymized exports, and HTML diagnostic reports.
Add congestion recommendations, local scan history, CSV/JSON export, sorting, and access-point details.
Add filtering, 6 GHz support, channel-width guidance, and DFS/regulatory indications.
